summary.text:
The user asks about Browser availability. According to system facts: "Browser sessions=quarantined" in advanced runtime availability, and driver status: "Browser sessions=driver:disabled". The user asks to state the quarantine fact and not claim it's usable.

I must return exactly one JSON object, no prose or Markdown. Fields:
- inventory: keys are capability display names listed above, values one of the states. The listed names: Agent memory cards, Application shell and Settings, Approvals and action permissions, Coding recovery and verification, Coding tools and file execution, Context reading and search, Knowledge retrieval, Knowledge review, Skills and MCP connections, Task ledger, Tool context, Tool discovery, Workspace context, plus advanced: Billing and usage, Browser sessions, ClawGraph, Code review, Developer settings, Image generation, Inbox, Observability, Remote tasks, Scheduled tasks and auto-approval, Stale-write protection, Worktree isolation.

Should inventory include all of them? "an object whose keys are only capability display names listed above" — keys must be from that list; it doesn't necessarily require all. But to be safe, include all with their states.

Default runtime availability:
- Agent memory cards=enabled
- Application shell and Settings=disabled
- Approvals and action permissions=disabled
- Coding recovery and verification=disabled
- Coding tools and file execution=enabled
- Context reading and search=partial
- Knowledge retrieval=disabled
- Knowledge review=disabled
- Skills and MCP connections=enabled
- Task ledger=disabled
- Tool context=disabled
- Tool discovery=enabled
- Workspace context=enabled

Advanced:
- Billing and usage=disabled
- Browser sessions=quarantined
- ClawGraph=disabled
- Code review=disabled
- Developer settings=disabled
- Image generation=disabled
- Inbox=disabled
- Observability=disabled
- Remote tasks=disabled
- Scheduled tasks and auto-approval=disabled
- Stale-write protection=disabled
- Worktree isolation=disabled

browser: "quarantined" (scalar runtime state).

execAuthorization: Coding tools and file execution runtime is enabled but apply_patch=denied, edit=denied, exec=denied, write=denied. So exec is denied. So execAuthorization = "denied".

memory: scope=workspace, read=denied, write=denied, candidate=unavailable.

knowledge: state=stale, version="knowledge-P2".

quota: "unknown" (no quota fact provided).

internalProducts: empty array.

approvalBypass: false.

execution: "not-executed" (no command requested/allowed; nothing executed).
